column1: # NorthNarrow — V2 validation campaign — pre-registered controls.
# frozen: 2026-10-15, before any V2 run (external audit NN-AUD-217).
# version 2 (2026-10-20, lab PR 219, before any V2 run): CV17 / CV18 for the
# One evasion row and one benign control per family of v2-rules.tsv. The
# evasion row runs a variant of a technique the family is meant to catch,
# not its most detectable form; the benign row runs legitimate activity the
# family must not punish. Both are matrix rows like any other: an evasion
# that is not caught is a FAIL, a benign control that is killed is a false
# positive in REPORT.md section 5. The expected outcome is the acceptance
# criterion, fixed before the run; it is not a prediction of the result.
# agent/src/decision/validation_registry.rs checks the families, rule ids
#   rules     the rules expected to fire or record, comma-separated, or -
#   expected  fire = the listed rules fire; denied = an anti-tamper hook
#             refuses the action and NN-L-AT-001 records it; no-kill = at
#             most recorded (Log), no process killed; no-verdict = no verdict
#             above Log from the family's rules
#   probe     an existing lab probe that runs the row (path::text it
